rules.name: cash-refresh-09-s7-null-price-diagnostic
rules.sql: SELECT 'cash_balance_report_for_scope' AS function_key, pg_get_functiondef('opera.fn_cash_balance_report_for_scope(character varying, character varying)'::regprocedure) AS definition
SELECT 'cash_balance_report_for_scope' AS function_key, pg_get_functiondef('opera_backup_04_10.fn_cash_balance_report_for_scope(character varying, character varying)'::regprocedure) AS definition

SELECT d.trade_id,d.tenant_id,d.business_unit,d.security_id, clone_si.derivative_type AS clone_derivative_type, main_si.derivative_type AS main_derivative_type, main_si.maturity_date,ssv.value_date AS ssv_value_date,ssv.settle_price, CASE WHEN main_si.derivative_type IS NULL THEN false WHEN lower(main_si.derivative_type) IN ('future','cs_future','fx_vanilla_call','fx_vanilla_put') THEN (v.value_date > main_si.maturity_date OR v.value_date <= main_si.maturity_date) WHEN lower(main_si.derivative_type) NOT IN ('future','cs_future','fx_vanilla_call','fx_vanilla_put') THEN true ELSE false END AS passes_s7_type_filter FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table d LEFT JOIN opera.cloned_security_info_table clone_si ON clone_si.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND clone_si.business_unit=d.business_unit AND clone_si.security_id=d.security_id LEFT JOIN opera.security_info_table main_si ON main_si.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND main_si.business_unit=d.business_unit AND main_si.security_id=d.security_id LEFT JOIN opera.security_settlement_value_table ssv ON ssv.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND ssv.business_unit=d.business_unit AND ssv.security_id=d.security_id AND ssv.value_date=:valueDate LEFT JOIN opera.valuation_date_table v ON v.tenant_id=ssv.tenant_id AND v.business_unit=ssv.business_unit AND v.value_date=ssv.value_date WHERE d.tenant_id=:tenant AND d.business_unit='CFS' AND d.trade_id IN ('TR-FY-2026-732789','TR-FY-2026-810936','TR-FY-2026-687639','TR-FY-2026-687640','TR-FY-2026-697702','TR-FY-2026-806333','TR-FY-2026-810935') ORDER BY d.trade_id

SELECT d.trade_id,d.tenant_id,d.business_unit,d.security_id, clone_si.derivative_type AS clone_derivative_type, main_si.derivative_type AS main_derivative_type, main_si.maturity_date,ssv.value_date AS ssv_value_date,ssv.settle_price, CASE WHEN main_si.derivative_type IS NULL THEN false WHEN lower(main_si.derivative_type) IN ('future','cs_future','fx_vanilla_call','fx_vanilla_put') THEN (v.value_date > main_si.maturity_date OR v.value_date <= main_si.maturity_date) WHEN lower(main_si.derivative_type) NOT IN ('future','cs_future','fx_vanilla_call','fx_vanilla_put') THEN true ELSE false END AS passes_s7_type_filter FROM opera_backup_04_10.cloned_deal_ticket_table d LEFT JOIN opera_backup_04_10.cloned_security_info_table clone_si ON clone_si.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND clone_si.business_unit=d.business_unit AND clone_si.security_id=d.security_id LEFT JOIN opera_backup_04_10.security_info_table main_si ON main_si.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND main_si.business_unit=d.business_unit AND main_si.security_id=d.security_id LEFT JOIN opera_backup_04_10.security_settlement_value_table ssv ON ssv.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND ssv.business_unit=d.business_unit AND ssv.security_id=d.security_id AND ssv.value_date=:valueDate LEFT JOIN opera_backup_04_10.valuation_date_table v ON v.tenant_id=ssv.tenant_id AND v.business_unit=ssv.business_unit AND v.value_date=ssv.value_date WHERE d.tenant_id=:tenant AND d.business_unit='CFS' AND d.trade_id IN ('TR-FY-2026-732789','TR-FY-2026-810936','TR-FY-2026-687639','TR-FY-2026-687640','TR-FY-2026-697702','TR-FY-2026-806333','TR-FY-2026-810935') ORDER BY d.trade_id
